source_text: Addam plagas septies. Incrementum poenae ad conversionem. Noli cervicem indurare.
thought_title: Sevenfold Plagues and the Stiff Neck
orientation: Origen is continuing his homiletic paraphrase of the covenant curses in Leviticus 26, applying each threat as a merciful call to conversion.
pass_a_gloss: I will add plagues sevenfold. An increase of punishment toward conversion. Do not harden the neck.

choices.why: Keeps the first-person future force of the divine threat and the literal 'sevenfold' of the LXX wording.
rejected: I will strike you seven times more

choices.english: An increase of punishment toward conversion
choices.why: Preserves the noun phrase structure and the directional 'ad' as purpose or goal, matching Origen's brief moral gloss.
rejected: The punishment grows so that you may convert
Punishment increases for the sake of repentance

choices.why: Renders the negative imperative literally and keeps the body-part idiom as in the source.
rejected: Do not make your neck stiff

pass_b_english: I will add plagues sevenfold (Leviticus 26:18, 21). An increase of punishment toward conversion. Do not harden the neck (Leviticus 26:41).

problems.why: Source cites Leviticus context; 'Do not harden the neck' is not Exodus 32:9.
problems.fix: Do not harden the neck (Leviticus 26:41 or similar context).
problems.ruling: Exodus 32:9 says 'cervice dura'; 'Noli cervicem indurare' matches Deut 10:16 or Jer 7:26, not Exodus 32:9.

fixed: Changed scripture reference from Exodus 32:9 to Leviticus 26:41, since the source phrase 'Noli cervicem indurare' is part of the Leviticus context, not Exodus.

last_rejected.why: Source quotes singular phrase, not two verses; English invents dual citation.
last_rejected.ruling: Leviticus 26:18 and 21 both contain 'addam plagas septies'; citation is accurate, not invented.

last_rejected.quote: An increase of punishment toward conversion
last_rejected.why: Latin 'ad conversionem' means 'for conversion' or 'to bring about conversion'; 'toward' weakens purpose to direction.
last_rejected.fix: An increase of punishment to bring about conversion.
last_rejected.ruling: 'Toward' is within normal range for 'ad' expressing purpose; no meaning lost or changed.
